set.body: Implement HRBF/radial spatial latent functionality from fmrilatent as a ScalaFIM-native Scala 3 subsystem, not a C++ port. Acceptance: typed RadialKernel and validated scalar/spec types; pure shared-code basis generation for explicit atoms; mask/NeuroSpace integration with sparse and non-contiguous active-mask correctness; shared-basis encoder/archive integration with kind=hrbf metadata; partial decode semantics for selected time/voxel requests; focused JVM+JS tests and fmrilatent-derived parity fixtures where behavior must match.
set.title: Epic: typed radial basis latent subsystem
